DTR · TALK ABOUT A SCENE

Nothing Touches the Floor

STS-HS11-L2-13001400-HSALG2-MCF-LAT-01 • HS Math Algebra II • Quadratic Equations with Complex Solutions
Look at the picture. You will answer some questions about it. Press the play button to hear each question. Record your answer for each question. You can listen to your answer and record it again. Click SUBMIT RECORDINGS when you have answered all the questions.
JUST FOR FUN · OPTIONAL
This bakery has stood on the same corner since 1974, and the family that built it drew the oven arch by hand before anyone in the neighborhood would sell them the bricks. Case 47 is the oldest folder in the drawer: the founder's equation promises the arch will land on the floor at two points, and in fifty years it has not landed once. Marisol says the equation is not wrong, it simply answers somewhere the floor cannot reach, and the two pins on the case wall are where that answer lives.
If an equation gives you an answer that no floor can hold, is the answer still real?
Optional. You do not have to record this one.
1
What is Marisol doing?
Look at the picture. Describe Marisol's action in a complete sentence, using exact words for her hand and for the place she is touching.
2
What is Joaquín holding?
Look at the picture. Describe what Joaquín is holding in a complete sentence, using exact words for the sheet and the shape on it.
3
What is the teacher doing?
Look at the picture. Describe the teacher's action in a complete sentence, using exact words for the folder and the drawer.
4
What place is this? How do you know?
Look at the picture. Identify the place in a complete sentence, then give two exact pieces of evidence, not general words like stuff.
5
Tell me about the case wall.
Look at the picture. Describe the case wall in three complete sentences, reading the printed wording exactly as it appears.
6
Tell me about what Lucía is wearing.
Look at the picture. Describe Lucía's clothing in a complete sentence, using exact color and garment words.
Record an answer for each question, then submit.
Content alignment: N-CN.7 — Solve quadratic equations with real coefficients that have complex solutions. ELD (Speaking — official ELPAC “Talk About a Scene”): PI.A.1, PII.B.3, PII.B.4, PII.B.5.
